units.multiplier: unitless factor on the base input price unless stated

sources.url: bundled skill claude-api (no URL; model table cached 2026-11-03 per the skill)
sources.title: Bundled claude-api skill

billing.formulaUsd: cost = sum over usage fields of tokens/1e6 * price (see usageFieldMap); then * dataResidencyMultiplier when usage.inference_geo is 'us'; tier chosen by usage.speed and (Haiku 5.5) prompt length.

usageFieldMap.meaning: Uncached input: tokens after the last cache breakpoint, not read from or written to cache
Sum of the two cache_creation values; use only as a fallback when cache_creation is absent, priced as 5m (the default TTL)
usageFieldMap.inferredNote: The docs state the sum identity; the 5m fallback follows from 5m being the default TTL.

usageFieldMap.meaning: Tokens served from cache; also covers refreshes
Generated tokens including thinking tokens, at the full thinking length even when thinking text is summarized or omitted
'fast' selects the fast tier; 'standard' the standard tier
'us' applies the data residency multiplier; 'global' is standard
usageFieldMap.unverifiedNote: Field name is from the claude-api skill; the pricing page names only the inference_geo request parameter.

usageFieldMap.meaning: Code execution calls; not billed per call: billed by container execution time (min 5 minutes, 1,550 free hours per month per organization, then 0.05 USD per container-hour); free alongside web search/fetch 20260209+

Per-iteration usage. A compaction iteration (type 'compaction') is billed like any request and reported only here; on an on-demand compaction response top-level input/output are 0, so sum across iterations. A 'fallback_message' type exists for server-side refusal fallback (billed at the fallback model's rates).
usageFieldMap.unverifiedNote: Exact semantics when both top-level totals and iterations are non-zero (threshold compaction, fallback) not read; the Messages API reference Usage schema could not be fetched.

contextTokensUsedByRequest.formula: input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens (all three count toward the window); the next request also carries this turn's output, so context for the next request is that sum + output_tokens (thinking excluded on models that strip prior thinking)
contextTokensUsedByRequest.inferredNote: Sum and 'add output_tokens' are stated by the docs; combining them into one next-request estimate is inferred.

cacheTtl.lifetimeStartsAt: start of the request that writes or reads the entry
cacheTtl.ordering: Longer-TTL entries must appear before shorter-TTL entries.
cacheTtl.cacheScopeNote: Separate caches per model and per speed (fast vs standard).

batch.explicitInputOutputPrices: Pricing page lists batch input/output for every model, each exactly 0.5x standard (Haiku 5.5 also 0.5x for both prompt-length tiers).
batch.cachePricesInBatch: Not listed explicitly; 0.5x of the standard cache prices by the stacking statement.

fastMode.multiplierNote: Fable 5.2/Mythos 5.2 16/80 vs 8/40, Opus 5.5 8/40 vs 4/20, Opus 5/4.8 10/50 vs 5/25: all exactly 2x; the docs call it 'a multiplier on standard rates' without stating 2x. The claude-api skill does say 2x for Opus 5.5.
fastMode.flatAcrossContext: Applies across the full context window, including requests over 200K input tokens.
fastMode.cacheStacking: Cache multipliers apply on top of fast pricing.
fastMode.fallbackBehavior: 429/529 on a fast request errors (SDK retries 429 twice by default); falling back to standard speed is a cache miss. Opus 4.6 historically ran at standard speed with usage.speed 'standard'.
fastMode.claudeCode: Claude Code /fast; subscription plans pay fast mode from usage credits only; Console/API orgs pay per token; Console can group by Speed.

dataResidency.appliesTo: all token categories incl. cache writes and reads
dataResidency.models: Claude 4.6 and later; earlier models reject the parameter with a 400
dataResidency.platforms: Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), Foundry US Data Zone Standard; not Bedrock / Google managed
dataResidency.claudeCodeBehavior: Claude Code multiplies the list price of a response billed at the residency rate by 1.1 in its session cost figure.

longContext.rule: Claude 4.6 and later models except Haiku 5.5 bill the full 1M window at standard per-token prices (no premium above 200K). Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length (over 100,000 prompt tokens costs 5x the base rates; see its tiers).

thinking.billedAs: output tokens at the full thinking length generated, not the summary shown
thinking.priorTurnThinking: Models that keep prior thinking (Opus 4.5+, Sonnet 4.6+, Haiku 5.5, Fable, Mythos): kept blocks are re-sent and billed as input (or cache read) and count toward the window. Earlier models strip prior-turn thinking automatically.
thinking.progressUpdates: Between-tool-call progress notes count toward output_tokens at full length, not the summary length.

toolUseOverheadTokens.note: System prompt tokens the API adds when tools are present (tool_choice auto/none; any/tool in parentheses).

tokenizer.note: Claude 4.7 and later (and Mythos Preview) use a newer tokenizer producing about 30% more tokens for the same text; Sonnet 4.6 and earlier use the previous one. Do not compare token counts across the boundary.

billing.subscriptionNote: On Pro/Max/Ultra/Team/Enterprise, token usage is inside the plan; Claude Code's dollar figure is a local list-price estimate (unless a managed modelPricing table applies). Fast mode and over-plan usage bill as usage credits.

anthropicApi.opusplan: opus in plan mode, sonnet otherwise

versionHistory.change: fable -> Fable 5.2; best -> same as opus

modelAliases.suffix: [1m] selects the 1M window for Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6; no effect on models with a native 1M window. The suffix is stripped before the ID is sent, so transcripts carry the plain model ID.

contextWindow.unknownModelId: Claude Code assumes a window for an unrecognized ID (1M for claude-* / [1m]); CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS corrects it.

env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT: =1 treats native-1M models as 200K and compacts at 200K

autoCompaction.defaultTriggerNote: Models with a native 1M window compact at about 967K by default (before the window fills). The docs give 'about 967K' only; the ~33K gap to 1,000,000 is presumably a reserved buffer (inferred).
200kBoundaryCases: 200K-window models (compact when the conversation reaches the model context limit; exact buffer not published)

setWindow.envPrecedence: env var beats command, flag and setting
setWindow.bareNumberRule: /autocompact: bare 100..1000 means thousands; env var: bare number means tokens (k/M suffix from v2.1.304)

autoCompaction.idleCompaction: Setting idleCompaction (false disables); a conversation left idle on the 1h TTL can be compacted. Requires v2.1.290 to turn off.
autoCompaction.compactionCost: The summarization is a separate request that repeats the system prompt, tools and history; warm cache reads the prefix, a cold cache reprocesses it as uncached input.
autoCompaction.afterCompaction: The next request rebuilds the conversation cache; re-reads up to 5 recent files (over 5,000 tokens: path only); skill bodies capped 5,000 each / 25,000 total.
autoCompaction.statusLineNote: status line used_percentage measures against the model's full window, not the compaction trigger.

everythingElse.description: subagents, workflows, teammates, forks, compaction, session titles
everythingElse.exception: a small set of server-controlled helper requests get 1h on subscriptions

promptCacheTtl.overQuotaRule: Once a subscription draws usage credits, the main conversation drops to 5m.

controls.ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H: =1 requests 1h for both, lowest explicit precedence

promptCacheTtl.minVersion: 2.1.242 for the TTL settings and env vars
promptCacheTtl.transcriptSignal: usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens vs ephemeral_5m_input_tokens shows which TTL was used (the docs recommend `claude -p --output-format json` to confirm).
promptCacheTtl.cacheScope: Effectively per machine and directory; model, speed and prefix must match. Subagents start their own cache (do not read the parent's); forks inherit it.

costReporting.dollarFigure: Computed locally from token counts at list price unless a managed modelPricing table is in effect; an estimate, not an invoice.
costReporting.residencyRate: x1.1 applied for responses billed at the data residency rate.
costReporting.perModelUsageLine: /usage prints input, output, cache read and cache write tokens per model and a dollar figure.

effortDefaults.cacheNote: Changing effort mid-session keeps the cache on Fable 5.1+, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 with API key or subscription; elsewhere it invalidates the cache.

cacheInvalidators: model switch (incl. opusplan toggles and automatic model fallback)
tool definition set change (when MCP tools load upfront)
